sn35.25:1.1: Sabbam abhiññā pariññā pahānāya vo bhikkhave dhammaṃ desissāmi || taṃ sunātha || || Katamo ca bhikkhave sabbam abhiññā pariññā pahānāya dhammo || || Cakkhum bhikkhave abhiññā pariññā pahātabbaṃ || rūpā abhiññā pariññā pahātabbā || cakkhuviññāṇam abhiññā pariññā pahātabbaṃ || cakkhusamphasso abhiññā pariññā pahātabbo || Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati veddayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi abhiññā pariññā pahātabbam || pe || jivhā abhiññā pariññā pahātabbā || rasā abhiññā pariññā pahātabbā || jivhāviññāṇaṃ abhiññā pariññā pahātabbaṃ || jivhāsamphasso abhiñña pariññā pahātabbo || yam pidam jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkham vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā tam pi abhiññā pariññā pahātabbam || pe || mano abhiññā pariññā pahātabbo || dhammā abhiññā pariññā pahātabbā || manoviññāṇam abhiññā pariññā pahātabbaṃ || manosamphasso abhiññā pariññā pahātabbo || Yam pidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi abhiññā pariññā pahātabbaṃ || || Ayam kho bhikkhave sabbam abhiññā pariññā pahānāya dhammo ti || ||
